budgetFields.label: Total Budget (USD)
budgetFields.note: Spending limits use known spend only: confirmed and estimated prices count toward the applicable limit; known $0 local calls are priced at $0 and do not use the limit. Unpriced calls stay without a price and are not counted as $0: they add nothing to known spend, so unpriced spending alone never triggers a limit. Open reservations and unresolved charges are not counted as spending. The Total Budget covers all work: once known spend reaches it, new paid calls are refused, API calls with an unknown price included, while known $0 calls and subscription or local calls on a route that has charged nothing continue. The Per-task Cost Cap covers one task's whole tree, subagents included: once that tree's known spend reaches it, every new model call of the tree is refused, known $0 and unpriced calls included. A resumable task pauses with its work saved; without a continuation it ends budget-exhausted. Calls already in flight settle normally and can overshoot the limit. Raising the cap does not resume a paused task; it must be resumed explicitly.
